api.decision_already_answered: This member has already answered this run. Change of mind is a new decision, not an overwritten one.
api.decision_not_acceptable: That answer is not one this run accepts.
api.no_such_run: That settlement run does not exist.
api.obligation_amount_not_positive: An amount has to be more than zero.
api.obligation_memo_too_long: That note is too long. Keep it under 280 characters.
api.obligation_request_incomplete: Something is missing from the request. A commitment needs both members, an amount and a note.
api.obligation_same_party: The same member cannot be both the debtor and the creditor.
api.obligation_unknown_currency: This deployment does not know that currency.
api.request_incomplete: Something is missing from the request.
fx.amount_too_small_to_convert: That amount is too small to convert: rounding it would make it vanish.
fx.invalid_rate: That exchange rate cannot be used.
fx.rate_stale: The exchange rate for this pair had expired when the commitment was recorded, so it was not used. Recording it again, later, will pick up a current rate.
fx.rate_unavailable: This deployment has no exchange rate for this pair yet. Cross-currency commitments are refused rather than converted at a guess.
ledger.currency_mismatch: This group settles in {expected}, but the amount is in {actual}.
rails.rejected: The payment rail refused this transfer.
rails.unreachable: The payment rail could not be reached.
settlement.already_decided: This run has already been decided.
settlement.currency_not_supported: The payment rail cannot settle that currency.
settlement.funding_not_positive: A funding has to be more than zero.
settlement.funding_not_required: This run is not waiting for that currency.
settlement.fx_unfunded: This run is waiting for currency to arrive before it can settle.
settlement.not_a_participant: That member is not a participant in this run.
settlement.nothing_to_settle: There is nothing to settle in this cycle.
settlement.not_waiting_on_the_group: This run is not waiting for approvals.
settlement.quorum_not_met: This run does not have the approvals it needs yet.
settlement.run_not_found: That settlement run does not exist.
settlement.run_rejected: This run was refused by a member.
settlement.transfer_already_resolved: That transfer has already been decided.
settlement.transfer_not_offered: That transfer has not been offered to a rail.
client.network: The server could not be reached. Check the connection and try again.
client.unexpected_status: The server answered in a way this screen does not understand.
client.unknown_fault: Something went wrong that this screen cannot explain.
client.unmapped: The server refused this request and this screen has no wording for the reason yet. The code is {code}.
amount.signed: Enter a positive amount: who pays whom is set by the two members, not by a minus sign.
amount.unparseable: That is not an amount this locale can read.
amount.too_many_decimals: That amount has more decimal places than the currency has.
amount.above_bound: That amount is larger than this deployment accepts.
amount.unknown_currency: This deployment does not have {currency} in its currency catalogue yet, so the amount cannot be shown.
amount.unsafe_integer: That amount cannot be read exactly and has been refused rather than rounded.
amount.negative: An amount is a magnitude; who pays whom carries the direction.
amount.not_a_currency_code: That is not a currency code.
